description:
Use this when you need an auditable division-specific count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when the division is unknown or employer/sector replacement-day rules matter.
What it computes: Counts working and non-working dates for a selected Malaysian division over the pinned 2027 schedule.
Example user requests: Count Kuala Lumpur working days from 2027-02-01 to 2027-02-15.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); division (enum); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-02-01","end_date":"2027-02-15","division":"KUL","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: normalized_start_date, normalized_end_date, working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, division, division_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, weekend_days, holiday_names, holiday_observed, rest_day_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += selected status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/malaysia-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/malaysia-working-days-between.md

division.description: Required federal-territory/state code: KUL, LBN, PJY, JHR, KDH, KTN, MLK, NSN, PHG, PRK, PLS, PNG, SBH, SWK, SGR or TRG.

name: count_my_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Selected division's federal/state public holidays and weekly baseline.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, official weekend or public holiday.

holiday_names.description: Official events applying to the date.

holiday_observed.description: Always false here because no substitute date is inferred.

is_working_day.description: False for the division's declared weekly baseline or applicable official holiday.

rest_day_policy.description: Employer roster and replacement-day policy are not inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Malaysia Division Working Days
